id: 28_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder – How to change different nozzle
title: 激光焊接机更换清洗嘴
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/28_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder – How to change different nozzle.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/28_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder – How to change different nozzle/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一把焊枪，旁边摆着两种不同形状的喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a handheld laser welding gun beside two differently shaped brass nozzles on the bench.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：焊接嘴怎样换成清洗嘴。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换清洗嘴

shots.scene: 四个步骤图标排成一行：电源开关、送丝管、焊接嘴、清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a power switch turned off, a wire feeding tube, a welding nozzle and a cleaning nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 一共四步，很快就能换好。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着一条发黑的焊缝，想把它清洗干净
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a dark weld seam on a metal plate and wants to clean it.
shots.narration: 阿杰焊完了，想清洗一下焊缝。

shots.scene: 焊枪头上装着送丝管和焊接嘴
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding gun tip still fitted with the wire feeding tube and the welding nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 可焊枪上装的还是焊接嘴。

shots.scene: 老李穿着白色工作服、戴着皮革耐热手套走过来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over in a white work suit and leather heat-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 老李说：清洗要换清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.

shots.scene: 穿白色工作服、戴皮革耐热手套的老李走到主机背面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a white work suit and leather heat-resistant gloves walks to the back of the main unit.

shots.scene: 老李按下主机背面的电源开关到关闭
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the rocker switch on the back of the main unit to off.

shots.scene: 主机屏幕熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen on the main unit goes dark. No people.

shots.scene: 焊枪头上卡着送丝管，卡扣被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding gun tip with the wire feeding tube clamped on, the clamp marked with a green circle. No people.

shots.scene: 老李戴着耐热手套打开卡扣
shots.prompt_en: Wearing leather heat-resistant gloves, the facility engineer opens the clamp on the gun tip.

shots.scene: 老李把送丝管从焊枪头上滑下来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the wire feeding tube off the welding gun tip.
shots.narration: 把送丝管从焊枪上取下来。

shots.scene: 送丝管放在台面一旁
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeding tube is laid aside on the bench. No people.

shots.scene: 焊枪头上的铜色焊接嘴特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the copper welding nozzle on the tip of the welding gun. No people.

shots.scene: 老李戴手套握住焊接嘴，逆时针拧
shots.prompt_en: The gloved facility engineer grips the copper welding nozzle and turns it counterclockwise.

shots.scene: 焊枪头上的焊接嘴已取下，老李手里拿着它
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun tip is now bare and the facility engineer holds the removed welding nozzle in his gloved hand.

shots.scene: 老李拿起一个形状不同的清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer picks up a differently shaped brass cleaning nozzle.

shots.scene: 老李把清洗嘴拧到焊枪头上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws the cleaning nozzle onto the welding gun tip.
shots.narration: 把清洗嘴拧到焊枪头上。

shots.scene: 装着清洗嘴的焊枪特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding gun now fitted with the cleaning nozzle. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣身后四个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the welding gun with four step icons behind: a power switch off, a tube, a nozzle out and a nozzle in.
shots.narration: 关机、拆管、拆焊嘴、装清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着第一个图标：电源开关
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the first icon, a power switch turned off.

shots.scene: 两个喷嘴并排：焊接嘴和清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: Two brass nozzles side by side: a welding nozzle and a differently shaped cleaning nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接用焊接嘴，清洗换清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着装好清洗嘴的焊枪点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds the welding gun fitted with the cleaning nozzle and nods.

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李和阿杰挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer and the young male student wave goodbye at the camera.
